title: Uplifting Crispy Moroccan Snow Peas Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish that combines the crunch of fried snow peas with the warmth of Moroccan spices. Serve as a side or main dish for a pescatarian-friendly meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large earthenware bowl over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute, until the spices are fragrant.
Add the snow peas to the bowl and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the crushed pistachios and preserved lemon to the bowl and stir to combine.
Increase the heat to high and fry the snow peas mixture for 2-3 minutes, until they are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the bowl from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the Uplifting Crispy Moroccan Snow Peas Tagine hot, garnished with additional crushed pistachios and preserved lemon if desired.
